issues.issue: Local Receipts: Other is about half of the year's receipts, and 201,011.90 of it sits in the Sinking Fund, which spent 192,903.23 on equipment and 51,807.00 on capital improvements. In the prior year the same line held 1,937,744.95 in the Bond Fund that was plainly bond proceeds (moved to Sinking and spent on 1,580,394 of capital outlay, p6). This year's Sinking Fund amount may also be loan/bond proceeds or a capital grant rather than ordinary revenue. decision_needed[] doesn't ask this

The budget-form rules don't require detail, and the worksheet agrees with the crossed-out version (Local Receipts Other 355,616.91), not the page that was used, so leaving it out is defensible.
